role: Research-stage short-horizon relative-value strategy for the market owner's current main versus the immediately adjacent next listed crude-oil futures contract. It consumes only the current visible curve, the published two-contract forecast vintage, the appointed PM style policy, existing positions and committee-authorized capital.
invariants: the strategy trades only the market owner's current main and the immediately adjacent next listed named contract; a mislabeled third-month contract is rejected
one positive spread unit is exactly long one main lot and short one next-main lot; one negative unit is the reverse
the primary alpha predicts and trades change in the dollar main-minus-next spread; current-price normalization is scale-only and can never reverse the sign of the dollar spread change
forecast capability or capability_total_score never enters signal magnitude, target sizing or risk capacity; only the published forecast values are consumed

the appointed PM reuses continuation_reversion, capital_deployment, responsiveness, selectivity, turnover_activity, holding_patience and forecast_horizon without adding a calendar-spread-specific PM quality field
committee-authorized capital remains an explicit input and is never multiplied by a shared PM deployment percentage; PM capital_deployment is reserved for risk-review semantics
risk capacity is the minimum of conservative pair margin, both leg limits, the all-contract gross limit and stressed visible spread-volatility capacity
expiry and roll checks use the oil-futures market owner's published months_to_expiry and never independently subtract another half turn
target positions are exactly balanced at one-to-one lots; any current or executed leg imbalance is reported separately and never relabeled as spread exposure

paired execution is one mandate with two independently recorded leg fills; remediation reservations and new pair requests share each leg's published half-turn trade limit, with remediation receiving capacity first
leg_imbalance_lots is signed; absolute_leg_imbalance_lots is the separate nonnegative risk magnitude
a material signal reversal requires the existing spread position to target zero before the opposite spread direction may be opened

each forecast leg must contain exactly one requested horizon and both legs must share the same target week identity; thesis evaluation requires the realized market week serial to equal that frozen target
calendar-spread PnL and residual directional PnL are separately attributable and add to gross leg PnL before costs
carry PnL is never accepted as a free-form number; it is computed only from explicit counterfactual leg end prices, otherwise carry is reported as not separately available
common oil-price movement with unchanged absolute dollar spread produces zero forecast spread-change signal and zero calendar-spread PnL
all decision inputs are available at the current cutoff; settlement and thesis evaluation may use only the subsequently realized end-of-turn prices
the strategy does not write back to the oil market, forecast, macro state or public liquidity
